text:
Sam: quick sync on the autoscale controls mock I dropped. main problem: the SLO knob screams for attention and pushes the pool selector down the page. thoughts on collapsing it into a header summary?
Priya: yes please. users get overwhelmed. what if we show a compact SLO pill: "SLO: 99.9th · 120ms" and make the full slider open inline? :sparkles: 
Dario: compact pill is good, but we still need to communicate impact. maybe add a tiny delta hint: "Est. +cost↑ if stricter" that expands into details.
Rina: accessibility callout 1 hover-only expansion will be invisible to keyboard. make the pill focusable and provide aria-expanded.
DesignBot: accessibility suggestion: pill should be a button with aria-pressed=false and aria-controls referencing the slider region. keyboard step=5ms.
Sam: noted. also re: labels — folks confuse "Max" and "Burst cap" in support tickets. proposal: rename 'Max' -> 'Sustained' and keep 'Burst' as a separate inline token. shorter and maybe clearer?
Priya: 'Sustained' might be ambiguous. users expect numbers like "Max". alternative: show secondary label under the number: "Max
(sustained)" small.
Dario: I'd avoid two-line labels on small chips. How about ornaments: top line number, tiny subtitle like 'sustained' under with muted color. keeps Max but clarifies.
Rina: also add example timeline in expanded help: ASCII mini-graph or 3-step: normal -> spike -> burst for 5min -> back. Visual helps non-technical PMs.
Sam: agree. include cost delta in that panel: "Burst cost: ~+12% for 5m spike (estimate)" and a link to docs. call it an estimate.
Priya: microcopy tweak for the burst explainer: start with 1-sentence definition: "Burst: temporary capacity on top of Max for short spikes." then bullet examples. people skim.
Dario: UI behavior idea: if SLO is very strict and current settings likely breach it, show a non-modal suggestion chip: "Suggest: Raise Min to 3" with small preview of cost and a one-click apply.
Rina: ensure that action has undo and is logged in audit trail for enterprise customers. also show exact change preview before applying.
DesignBot: contrast check: suggestion chip uses --info-strong and passes AA at 12px. warning badges should use --warning-strong token at >=14px.
Sam: final question — pool selector: current multi-select chips break onto multiple lines and look noisy. idea: collapsed summary like "3 pools selected" with a dropdown that shows chips. keep quick glance readable.
Priya: yes collapse when >2 selections. show 2 chips + "+N" token. works on mobile too.
Dario: one more keyboard thing: ensure the dropdown is properly trapped and Esc closes it. focus returns to the summary button.
Rina: timeline for updates? I can mock the compact pill and expanded panel by tomorrow noon.
Sam: perfect. Priya will draft the microcopy and Dario will spec the aria changes and cost hook. I'll follow up in product sync with annotated Figma comments. :thumbsup:
